G2400.def:
ἰδού,
[in LXX chiefly for הִנֵּה,]
prop. imperat. 2 aor. mid. of ὁράω, used as a demonstrative particle, with frequency much greater in LXX and NT than in cl. (see M, Pr., 11),
lo, behold, see: Mt 10:16 11:8 13:3, Mc 3:32, Lc 2:48, 1Co 15:51, Tg 5:9, Ju 14, Ap 1:7, al.; after genitive absol., Mt 1:20 2:1, 13 12:46, al.; καὶ ἰδού, Mt 2:9 (and freq.), Lc 1:20 10:25, At 12:7, al.; in elliptical sentences, taking the place of copula or predicate (like הִנֵּה in Heb.), Mt 3:17, Lc 5:12 22:31, 47 At 8:27, 36 al.
(AS)

G2401.def:

G2403.def:

G2404.def:
Ἱεράπολις (WH, Ἱερὰ Πόλις), -εως, ἡ
Hierapolis: a city in the Lyons valley in the Province of Asia: Cl 4:13.†
(AS)

G2405.def:
ἱερατεία (WH, -ία), -ας, ἡ

G2406.def:

(ἱερατεύω), [in LXX: βασίλειον ἱ., Êx 19:1-25 6:1-30 (כֹּהֵן מַמְלָכָה) Êx 23:22, 2Ma.2:17 * ;]

(AS)

G2407.def:
ἱερατεύω
(cl. = ἱεράομαι) [in LXX chiefly for כָּהַן pi. ;]

(AS)

G2408.def:

G2409.def:

(AS)

G2411.def:
ἱερός, -ά, όν
[in LXX: Eze.28:18 (מִקְדָּשׁ); τό ἱ, 1Cr 29:4 (בַּיִת), Eze.45:19 (עֲזָרָה); very frequently in I Et 1:1-58 -4 Mac ;]
__1. in Hom., marvellous, mighty, divine.
__2. (Also in Hom, and later cl.) consecrated to the deity, sacred: pl., ἱ. γράμματα, 2Tm 3:15.
__3. As subst.,
__(a) (so in Hom.), τὰ ἱ., sacrifices, sacred rites, sacred things: 1Co 9:13;
__(b) later, τὸ ἱ.,., a consecrated or sacred place, a temple: τ. Ἀρτέμιδος, At 19:27; of the temple at Jerusalem, i.e. the entire precincts or some part thereof (as distinct from ὁ ναός, which see, the Sanctuary proper): 1Co 9:13, and frequently in Gosp. and esp. in Ac, Mt 12:6, Mc 13:3, At 4:1, al. (on the use of ἱ. in Imperial Iuser., see Deiss., LAE, 380 f.)
(AS)

G2443.def:
ἵνα,
__I. adverb (poët., Hom., al.),
__1. of place, where, whither.
__2. of circumstance, when.
__II. Conjunction,
__1. prop., final, denoting purpose or end (cl.), that, in order that, usually the first word in the clause, but sometimes (cl. also) preceded by an emphatic word (At 19:4, Rm 11:31 (?), Gl 2:10, al.);
__(a) with optative (so in cl. after historic tenses): after a pres., Ef 1:17 (but WH, mg., subjc.; see Burton, §225, Rem., 2);
__(b) with subjc.: after a pres., Mc 4:21, Lc 6:34, Jo 3:15, At 2:25, Rm 1:11, al.; after a pf., Mt 1:22, Jo 5:23 1Co 9:22, al.; after an imperat. (present or aor.), Mt 7:1, Mc 11:25, Jo 10:38, 1Co 7:5, al.; after a delib. subjc., Mc 1:38, al.; after a fut., Lc 16:4, Jo 14:3, 1Co 15:28, al.; after historic tenses (where optative in cl.; WM, 359f.; M, Pr., 196f.), Mc 6:41 (impf.), Jo 4:8 (plpf.), Mc 3:14 (aor.), al.;
__(with) in late writers (M, Pr., 35; Burton, §§198, 199), with indic., fut: Lc 20:10, 1Pe 3:1, al.;
__(d) as often in eccl. writers (Thayer, see word), with indic. pres.: 1Co 4:6, Gl 4:17, al. (?; but V. Burton, §198, Rem.);
__(e) εἰς (διὰ) τοῦτο, ἵνα: Jo 18:37, 1Tm 1:16, al.; τούτου χάριν, Tt 1:5;
__(f) elliptical constructions: omission of the principal verb, Jo 1:8, 2Ts 3:9, 1Jo 2:19, al.; of the final verb, Rm 4:16, 2Co 8:13, al.
__2. In late writers, definitive, = inf. (WM, 420; Bl, §69, 1), that;
__(a) after verbs of wishing, caring, striving, etc.: θέλω, Mt 7:12, al.; ζητῶ, 1Co 4:2 14:12; ζηλόω, 1Co 14:1, al.;
__(b) after verbs of saying, asking, exhorting: εἰπεῖν, Mt 4:3, al.; ἐρωτῶ, Mc 7:26, al.; παρακαλῶ, Mt 14:36, 1Co 1:10, al., etc.;
__(with) after words expressing expediency, etc.: συμφέρει, Mt 18:6, Jo 11:50, al.; ἱκανός, Mt 8:8, Lc 7:6; χρείαν ἔχω, Jo 2:25, al, etc.;
__(d) after substantives, adding further definition: ὥρα, Jo 12:23 13:1; χρόνος, Ap 2:21; συνήθεια, Jo 18:39; μισθός, 1Co 9:18.
__3. In late writers, ecbatic, denoting the result, = ὥστε, that, so that (M, Pr., 206ff.; WM, 572; Bl., §69, 3; Burton, §223): Rm 11:11, 1Co 7:29, 1Ts 5:4, al. (but see Thayer, see word); so with the formula referring to the fulfilment of prophecy, ἵνα πληρωθῇ, Mt 1:22 2:14, Jo 13:18, al.
(AS)

G2475.def:

(Rec. -λίτης), ου, ὁ [in LXX: Nm 25:8 (יִשְׂרָאֵל), 3Ki.21:1 (יִזְרְעֵאלִי; Luc. Ἰεζραηλίτης), etc. ;]

G2476.def:
ἵστημι, and in late writers, also ἱστάνω (Veitch, see word; Bl., §23, 2; M, Pr., 55), [in LXX chiefly for עמד, קוּם, also for נצב ni., hi., יצב hith., etc.].
__I. Trans, in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act. and in the tenses of the pass.
__1. to make to stand, to place, set, set up, establish, appoint: with accusative of person(s), Mc 7:9, At 1:23 6:13 17:31, Hb 10:9; id. before ἐπί, with accusative loc, Mt 4:5, Lc 4:9; ἐν μέσῳ, Mt 18:2, Mc 9:36, Jhn.8:[3]; ἐνώπιον, At 6:6; παρ᾽ ἑαυτῷ, Lc 9:47; ἐκ δεξιῶν, Mt 25:33; mid., to place oneself, to stand: Ap 18:15; so also pass., to be made to stand, to stand: Mt 2:9, Lc 11:18 19:8, 2Co 13:1, al.
__2. to set in a balance, to weigh (cl.; LXX for שׁקל, Is 46:6, al.): Mt 26:15,
__II. Intrans., in pf., plpf. (with sense of present and impf.; M, Pr., 147f.) and 2 aor. act., to stand, stand by, stand still: Mt 20:32 26:73, Mc 10:49, Lc 8:44, Jo 1:35 3:29, At 16:9, al.; before ἐν, Mt 6:5, al.; ἐνώπιον, At 10:30, al.; πρός, with dative loc., Jo 18:16; ἐπί, with genitive loc., Lc 6:17, At 5:23 25:10, al.; ἔμπροσθεν, Mt 27:11; κύκλῳ, Ap 7:11; ἐκ δεξιῶν, Lc 1:11; ἐπί, with accusative, Mt 13:2, Ap 3:20; παρά, Lc 5:2; ἐκεῖ, Mc 11:5; ὧδε, Mc 9:1; ὅπου, Mc 13:14; ἔξω, Mt 12:46; μακρόθεν, Lc 18:13; πόρρωθεν, Lc 17:12. Metaphorical, to stand ready, stand firm, be steadfast: 1Co 7:37 10:12, Ef 6:11, 13 14, Cl 4:12; τ. πίστει, Rm 11:20; ἐν τ. ἀληθείᾳ, Jo 8:44; εν τ. χάριτι, Rm 5:2; ἐν τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, 1Co 15:1 (cf. ἀν-, ἐπ-ἀν-, ἐξ-ἀν, ἀνθ-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐν-, ἐξ-, ἐπ- (-μαι), ἐφ-, κατ-ἐφ-, συν-ἐφ-, καθ-, ἀντι-καθ-, ἀπο-καθ-, μεθ-, παρ-, περι-, προ-, συν-ίστημι).
(AS)

__2. C. accusative of person(s), to inquire of or about.
__3. to narrate, record.
__4. In late writers, to visit, become acquainted with: Gl 1:18 (see Ellic., in l, and cf. MM, Exp., xv).†

G2478.def:

strong, mighty, powerful;
__(a) of persons, as to body or spirit: Mt 12:29, Mc 3:27, Lc 11:21-22, 1Co 4:10 (opposite to ἀσθενής), Hb 11:34 (ἐν πολέμῳ), Ap 5:2 10:1 18:21 19:18; οἱ πλούσιοι κ. οἱ ἰ, Ap 6:15; τὰ ἰ. = oἱ ἰ. (cf. 4Ki.24:15), 1Co 1:27; of God (cf. Dt 10:17), Ap 18:8; compar., Mt 3:11, Mc 1:7, Lc 11:22, 1Co 1:25 (τὸ ἀσθενὲς τ. θεοῦ) 1Co 10:22;
__(b) of things: λιμός, Lc 15:14; ἐπιστολαί ( βαρεῖαι κ. ἰ.), 2Co 10:10; κραυγή, Hb 5:7; φωνή, Ap 18:2; παράκλησις, Hb 6:18; πόλις, Ap 18:10; βρονταί, Ap 19:6.†
(AS)

ἰσχύς, -ύος, ἡ
